scope: Local one-batch inference conditional on legacy pre-observation Gaussian component priors; no counterfactual trajectory or deployment-reward claim.
base_protocol: Use the saved stage-A execution_plan.json base_protocol and its n24_v928 allocation.
site_rule: For each of the 160 archived paths, probe the last paid batch at its original recommendation. Record the three unobserved recommendations without inventing observations.

additional_anchor.reason: Post hoc regression identified in stage A; report separately from original-winner sites.

likelihood: For each original component pair, integrate its eta prior times the batch log-variance likelihood and the marginalized g batch-mean likelihood; g conditional on eta remains Gaussian. Retain posterior g/eta covariance and component probabilities.
source_information: Source selection and ARD parameters stay fixed; target supports and simulator truth enter only post-inference diagnostics.
scoring: Compute immediate local posterior errors and verifier power for all variants at each paid site; preserve every regime/arm and the separate anchor. Explain any difference between exact component-mixture power and legacy moment-matched power.
partial_results: Retain completed sites; an incomplete cohort supports no full-cohort diagnostic claim.
next_step: Use the findings to choose risk-support correction versus a likelihood change; do not promote a local likelihood probe as a full-method fix.
